content:
mae: quick note - after int4 packaging for comet-lite we see a stray token for U+E0100 (IVS) causing detok spaces on zh->ja samples; BLEU down ~2.1.

owen: can you paste a tiny repro?

mae: repro: `printf '漢0字' | ./tokenize --model models/comet-lite-int4` -> tokens: ["漢","\uE0100","字"] ; float kept merged or invisible VS.

li: looks like packaging remap split the combined token during vocab truncation. The quant remapper assigns ids by frequency and low-frequency multi-codepoint entries can be split.

tz: detok inserts a space when it sees a standalone Cf/Cc token; that spacing rule was harmless before because VS wasn't a token.

mae: short mitigation: (A) quick repack to preserve float token ids for multi-codepoint entries, (B) add IVS cases to packaging parity guard, (C) avoid edge-normalizer since customers care about glyph variants.

owen: i ran a remap script that reassigns the VS to the original combined id; local smoke shows detok parity on the IVS set. uploading artifact: s3://redwood-staging/models/comet-lite-int4-remap-20260326.tar.gz

ci-bot: nightly-regression: comet-lite-int4 vs float: BLEU 30.9 -> 28.8 (-2.1); detok exact 94.8% -> 89.9%.

mae: plan: 1) canary A/B (current vs remap) 2) merge packaging guard that diffs detok outputs on a 30-sample IVS+ZWJ+punct set 3) add unit to detok/regress.

deploy-bot: canary queued: comet-lite-int4 remap -> canary-asia (job j-8102).

li: if canary confirms, we'll make repack standard for int4/int8 pipelines and add checklist entry: "preserve multi-codepoint special-codepoint token ids".

owen: tests queued; will follow up with canary metrics. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
